description.de: Erstellt Songs auf Suno aus vorhandenen Lyrics-Dateien via Chromium CDP-Session
description.en: Creates songs on Suno from existing lyrics files via Chromium CDP session

config.command: echo '=== Suno Batch Pre-Check ===' && echo '' && echo '--- CDP Connection ---' && if curl -s --max-time 5 http://localhost:9222/json/version > /dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'CDP on port 9222: OK'; else echo 'CDP on port 9222: NOT REACHABLE'; echo 'Start Chromium with: chromium --remote-debugging-port=9222'; exit 1; fi && echo '' && echo '--- Lyrics Files ---' && LYRICS_DIR='{{ base_dir }}/{{ lang_pair }}/{{ collection }}' && LYRICS_COUNT=$(find "$LYRICS_DIR" -name '*.txt' 2>/dev/null | wc -l) && echo "Directory: $LYRICS_DIR" && echo "Lyrics files found: $LYRICS_COUNT" && if [ "$LYRICS_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then echo 'ERROR: No lyrics files found'; exit 1; fi && echo '' && echo '--- Existing Downloads ---' && AUDIO_COUNT=$(find "$LYRICS_DIR" -name '*.mp3' -o -name '*.wav' 2>/dev/null | wc -l) && echo "Audio files already present: $AUDIO_COUNT" && echo "Remaining to generate: $((LYRICS_COUNT - AUDIO_COUNT))"
config.label: Pre-Check: CDP & Lyrics

config.command: cd {{ base_dir }} && bash scripts/suno_batch_pipx.sh --session-mode cdp --continue-on-error --skip-existing --delay {{ delay }} --delay-jitter {{ delay_jitter }} --song-timeout {{ song_timeout }} --max-downloads {{ max_downloads }} '{{ lang_pair }}/{{ collection }}/*.txt'
config.label: Suno Batch Generation

config.command: echo '=== Suno Batch Results ===' && echo '' && LYRICS_DIR='{{ base_dir }}/{{ lang_pair }}/{{ collection }}' && LYRICS_COUNT=$(find "$LYRICS_DIR" -name '*.txt' 2>/dev/null | wc -l) && AUDIO_COUNT=$(find "$LYRICS_DIR" -name '*.mp3' -o -name '*.wav' 2>/dev/null | wc -l) && echo "Total lyrics files: $LYRICS_COUNT" && echo "Total audio files:  $AUDIO_COUNT" && echo "Success rate: $AUDIO_COUNT / $LYRICS_COUNT" && echo '' && echo '--- Missing Songs ---' && for txt in "$LYRICS_DIR"/*.txt; do base=$(basename "$txt" .txt); if [ ! -f "$LYRICS_DIR/$base.mp3" ] && [ ! -f "$LYRICS_DIR/$base.wav" ]; then echo "  MISSING: $base"; fi; done && echo '' && echo 'Done.'
config.label: Result Summary
